notes.path: e4 c5
notes.text: The Sicilian Defence. Black fights for d4 from the flank and creates an unbalanced game where both sides play to win. Against 2.Nf3, Black plays 2...d6.

notes.path: e4 c5 Nf3 d6
notes.text: Black guards e5 and prepares ...Nf6. After 3.d4, Black trades a flank pawn for a centre pawn with cxd4.

notes.path: e4 c5 Nf3 d6 d4 cxd4 Nxd4 Nf6 Nc3
notes.text: The Open Sicilian. Black chooses the Najdorf with 5...a6, keeping White's pieces off b5 and preparing ...e5 or ...b5.

notes.path: e4 c5 Nf3 d6 d4 cxd4 Nxd4 Nf6 Nc3 a6 Be2
notes.text: White chooses the solid Classical set-up. Black strikes in the centre with 6...e5, claiming space and opening the f8 bishop.

notes.path: e4 c5 Nf3 d6 d4 cxd4 Nxd4 Nf6 Nc3 a6 Be2 e5 Nb3
notes.text: The d5 square is slightly weak, yet Black's active pieces compensate. Black develops 7...Be7 and castles quickly.

notes.path: e4 c5 Nf3 d6 d4 cxd4 Nxd4 Nf6 Nc3 a6 Be3
notes.text: The English Attack prepares Qd2, f3 and O-O-O. Black counters in the centre with 6...e5, fighting for d4.

notes.path: e4 c5 Nf3 d6 d4 cxd4 Nxd4 Nf6 Nc3 a6 Bg5
notes.text: White pins the f6 knight and prepares a sharp kingside attack. Black blocks the pin solidly with 6...e6.

notes.path: e4 c5 Nf3 d6 d4 cxd4 Nxd4 Nf6 Nc3 a6 Bg5 e6 f4
notes.text: White threatens e5 or f5 to break open the centre. Black unpins cleanly with 7...Be7.

notes.path: e4 c5 Nf3 d6 d4 cxd4 Nxd4 Nf6 Nc3 a6 Bc4
notes.text: White aims the bishop at f7 and e6. Black shuts down that diagonal right away with 6...e6.

notes.path: e4 c5 Nf3 d6 Bb5+
notes.text: The Moscow Variation avoids Open Sicilian theory with a check. Black calmly blocks with 3...Bd7.

notes.path: e4 c5 Nf3 d6 Bb5+ Bd7 Bxd7+
notes.text: White trades dark-squared bishops. Black recaptures 4...Qxd7 to keep c6 free for the knight and develop smoothly.

notes.path: e4 c5 Nf3 d6 c3
notes.text: The Delayed Alapin tries to build a big centre with d4. Black attacks e4 immediately with 3...Nf6.

notes.path: e4 c5 Nf3 d6 d4 cxd4 Qxd4
notes.text: The Chekhover Variation recaptures with the queen. Black gains time at once with 4...Nc6.

notes.path: e4 c5 c3
notes.text: The Alapin Variation prepares 3.d4 to build a full pawn centre. Black hits e4 right away with 2...Nf6.

notes.path: e4 c5 c3 Nf6 e5 Nd5 d4 cxd4
notes.text: Black swaps off a flank pawn and exposes White's centre. Against 5.cxd4, Black strikes back with 5...d6.

notes.path: e4 c5 d4 cxd4 c3
notes.text: The Smith-Morra Gambit offers a pawn for rapid development. Black accepts with 3...dxc3 and builds a rock-solid shield.

notes.path: e4 c5 d4 cxd4 c3 dxc3 Nxc3 Nc6 Nf3
notes.text: White aims all pieces towards the centre and f7. Black plays 5...d6 to control e5 and prepare ...e6.

notes.path: e4 c5 Nc3
notes.text: The Closed Sicilian avoids d4 for now. Black mirrors White's control of d4 with 2...Nc6.

notes.path: e4 c5 Nc3 Nc6 g3
notes.text: White prepares a kingside fianchetto. Black answers with ...g6 and ...Bg7 to fight for the dark squares.

notes.path: e4 c5 Nc3 Nc6 f4
notes.text: The Grand Prix Attack aims for a kingside storm. Black fianchettoes with 3...g6 to blunt White's attack.

notes.path: e4 c5 Nc3 Nc6 f4 g6 Nf3 Bg7 Bb5
notes.text: White threatens to double Black's pawns on c6. Black jumps into the centre with 5...Nd4.

notes.path: e4 c5 f4
notes.text: Against the immediate 2.f4, Black strikes in the centre before White develops. Playing 2...d5 challenges e4 at once.
